latestVersion.changelog:
gpu-check 1.0.0

- Added real-time monitoring of GPU memory usage for distributed AI nodes (3090 and 4090) on the local network.
- Output includes a progress bar in a Markdown table format.
- Automatically checks API service availability for each monitored node.
- Simple chat commands supported for querying GPU status.
- Requires Node.js and axios library for operation.
